newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Jan 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Jan 17.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Manila newspapers on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Energy Regulatory Board yesterday raised by an avearge of 26 centavos per litre the pump prices of diesel and eight other petroleum products. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)

- The Palace said yesterday there is already an existing law that effectively establishes a national identification card system. It cited the National Health Insurance Law which was enacted by Congress in 1995. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)
- President Ramos, in an apparent bid to break the deadlock on the proposed national budget, began meeting one-on-one with senators yesterday.(STAR)
- The state-run National Power Corp will bring down its basic rates by three centavos next month to reflect the efficient operation of its oil-based thermal power plants. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)
- The Monetary Board has approved a 100 percent increase in over-the-counter dollar transactions to $50,000 from $25,000. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)
- The government generated proceeds of 5.6 billion pesos from the sale of state assets last year, sharply down from the projected revenues of 21.5 billion pesos.
